description: Single-file Wordle clone: embedded dictionary of 5-letter answers and larger valid-guess list, 6 guesses, green/yellow/gray feedback with duplicate-letter rules, on-screen keyboard, hard mode, stats with streak in localStorage, emoji-grid share text.

criteria: wordle_model_01.html is one self-contained Wordle clone (no libraries): an embedded answer list of at least 200 common 5-letter words plus a larger valid-guess dictionary or permissive validation, exactly 6 guesses with green/yellow/gray coloring that handles duplicated letters correctly (consumed left-to-right), a physical and on-screen keyboard that reflects the best known state per letter, rejected invalid guesses with a message, hard mode that forces revealed hints, game-over reveal of the answer, per-played/win-rate/streak statistics in localStorage, and a copy-to-clipboard emoji grid share. No random colorings.
